1_DEFINITIONS.document_type: Mutual NDA - General Commercial Business (Mutual)

1.1_Affiliate.definition: "Affiliate" means, with respect to any Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with such Party, where "control" means the ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights or the power to direct the management and policies of such entity.

1.2_Agreement.definition: "Agreement" means this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, including all schedules, annexures, exhibits, amendments, modifications, and supplements hereto.

1.3_Applicable_Law.definition: "Applicable Law" means any statute, law, ordinance, regulation, rule, notification, circular, order, judgment, decree, directive, governmental approval, or other legal requirement having the force of law and applicable to the Parties or the subject matter of this Agreement.

1.4_Authorized_Recipient.definition: "Authorized Recipient" means any Representative who has a legitimate need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose and who is bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those contained herein.

1.5_Business_Day.definition: "Business Day" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday on which banks are open for business in the jurisdiction specified in this Agreement.

1.6_Confidential_Information.definition: "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by or on behalf of a Party ("Disclosing Party") to the other Party ("Receiving Party"), whether before, on, or after the Effective Date, in written, oral, visual, electronic, digital, graphic, machine-readable, or any other form, including but not limited to: (a) business plans, strategies, forecasts, and opportunities; (b) financial information, budgets, pricing, costs, revenues, and projections; (c) technical information, specifications, designs, drawings, schematics, models, formulas, inventions, know-how, discoveries, methodologies, and processes; (d) software, source code, object code, algorithms, databases, architecture, and technical documentation; (e) customer, supplier, contractor, consultant, and business partner information; (f) research and development information; (g) intellectual property and proprietary information; (h) trade secrets; (i) contractual arrangements and commercial terms; (j) data, reports, analyses, studies, compilations, summaries, notes, and derivative materials prepared from Confidential Information; and (k) any information that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential in nature. (a) business plans, strategic plans, growth plans, expansion plans, and market entry strategies; (b) financial information, budgets, forecasts, financial models, pricing structures, profit margins, cost data, revenue projections, investment plans, and funding strategies; (c) customer information, customer lists, customer requirements, purchasing history, customer contracts, customer communications, and customer relationship information; (d) supplier, vendor, distributor, contractor, consultant, advisor, and service provider information, including commercial arrangements, procurement information, pricing structures, and contractual terms; (e) commercial proposals, quotations, bids, tenders, requests for proposals, requests for quotations, procurement documents, and related negotiations; (f) product information, service information, product roadmaps, development plans, commercialization strategies, product specifications, and business methodologies; (g) operational processes, internal procedures, workflows, policies, management reports, business processes, and operational information; (h) marketing plans, advertising strategies, sales strategies, market research, market intelligence, and competitive analyses; (i) intellectual property information, proprietary methodologies, trade secrets, know-how, inventions, concepts, and innovations; and (j) any other proprietary, strategic, commercial, financial, operational, or business information disclosed in connection with the Purpose.

1.7_Data_Protection_Laws.definition: "Data Protection Laws" means all applicable laws relating to privacy, data protection, information security, and processing of personal data.

1.8_Disclosing_Party.definition: "Disclosing Party" means the Party disclosing or making available Confidential Information to the Receiving Party.

1.9_Effective_Date.definition: "Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement is executed by the last signing Party.

1.10_Governmental_Authority.definition: "Governmental Authority" means any court, tribunal, arbitrator, ministry, department, commission, authority, regulator, agency, instrumentality, or other governmental or quasi-governmental body having jurisdiction.

1.11_Intellectual_Property_Rights.definition: "Intellectual Property Rights" means all patents, patent applications, copyrights, trademarks, service marks, trade names, domain names, designs, database rights, moral rights, trade secrets, know-how, and all other intellectual property rights recognized under Applicable Law.

1.12_Permitted_Disclosure.definition: "Permitted Disclosure" means any disclosure expressly permitted under this Agreement, including disclosures to Authorized Recipients, Affiliates, professional advisors, auditors, lenders, investors, or disclosures required by Applicable Law.

1.13_Person.definition: "Person" includes any individual, corporation, company, partnership, limited liability partnership, trust, association, joint venture, governmental authority, or other legal entity.

1.14_Personal_Data.definition: "Personal Data" means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person as defined under applicable Data Protection Laws.

1.15_Purpose.definition: "Purpose" means the evaluation, discussion, negotiation, assessment, and exploration of a potential business relationship, commercial arrangement, transaction, collaboration, strategic opportunity, or other business opportunity between the Parties.

1.16_Protected_Material.definition: "Protected Material" means Confidential Information and all copies, extracts, summaries, analyses, reports, notes, compilations, derivative works, and materials derived therefrom.

1.17_Receiving_Party.definition: "Receiving Party" means the Party receiving Confidential Information from the Disclosing Party.

1.18_Representatives.definition: "Representatives" means a Party's directors, officers, employees, consultants, legal counsel, auditors, accountants, financial advisors, agents, contractors, and Affiliates.

1.19_Residual_Knowledge.definition: "Residual Knowledge" means information retained in the unaided memory of an individual without intentional memorization and without reference to any written or electronic records of Confidential Information.

1.20_Security_Incident.definition: "Security Incident" means any unauthorized access, acquisition, use, disclosure, alteration, loss, destruction, compromise, or breach of Confidential Information.

1.21_Third_Party.definition: "Third Party" means any Person other than the Parties and their Authorized Recipients.

1.22_Trade_Secret.definition: "Trade Secret" means information that derives independent economic value from not being generally known or readily ascertainable and is subject to reasonable efforts to maintain its secrecy.

1.23_Written_Notice.definition: "Written Notice" means a notice delivered by hand, courier, registered post, or electronic mail in accordance with the Notice provisions of this Agreement.

1.24_Business_Opportunity.definition: "Business Opportunity" means any actual, proposed, contemplated, or potential transaction, project, investment, acquisition, merger, joint venture, strategic alliance, partnership, procurement opportunity, service engagement, licensing arrangement, distribution arrangement, commercial relationship, customer engagement, supplier relationship, acquisition opportunity, or other opportunity discussed, evaluated, negotiated, or pursued by the Parties in connection with the Purpose.

1.25_Commercial_Information.definition: "Commercial Information" means any information relating to the commercial, business, operational, strategic, marketing, sales, procurement, or financial activities of a Party, including pricing information, quotations, bids, tenders, commercial proposals, business plans, market strategies, customer acquisition strategies, sales forecasts, profit margins, revenue models, procurement plans, contractual arrangements, and other commercially sensitive information.

1.26_Business_Relationship.definition: "Business Relationship" means any existing, proposed, prospective, or contemplated commercial relationship, transaction, engagement, collaboration, partnership, service arrangement, supply arrangement, licensing arrangement, procurement arrangement, investment relationship, or other business interaction between the Parties or involving a Party and a third party.

1.27_Strategic_Information.definition: "Strategic Information" means any information relating to the long-term objectives, growth plans, expansion plans, investment strategies, business initiatives, organizational strategies, restructuring plans, acquisition plans, partnership strategies, or other strategic decisions of a Party.

clauses.16.1: Neither Party shall, without the prior written consent of the other Party, issue or make any press release, public announcement, media statement, advertisement, marketing communication, investor communication, website publication, social media post, or other public disclosure concerning: (a) the existence of this Agreement; (b) the Purpose; (c) the existence or status of discussions, negotiations, or communications between the Parties; (d) the exchange of Confidential Information pursuant to this Agreement; or (e) any proposed transaction, collaboration, investment, business relationship, or commercial arrangement contemplated by the Parties.
clauses.16.2: Neither Party shall use the name, logo, trademark, trade name, service mark, brand, or other identifying information of the other Party in any public communication, promotional material, advertisement, publication, or marketing activity without the prior written consent of the other Party.
clauses.16.3: Notwithstanding anything contained herein, either Party may make a disclosure to the extent required by: (a) Applicable Law; (b) any stock exchange or securities regulatory requirement; (c) any Governmental Authority; (d) any court, tribunal, or arbitral authority having jurisdiction; or (e) any regulatory, compliance, or reporting obligation applicable to such Party, Provided that, to the extent legally permissible, the disclosing Party shall promptly notify the other Party and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment or protective measures with respect to such disclosure.
clauses.16.4: Any disclosure made pursuant to Clause 16.3 shall be limited to the minimum information legally required to be disclosed.
clauses.16.5: The obligations contained in this Clause shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement for a period of two (2) years thereafter.
